Page 697 
Gamifant (emapalumab-lzsg) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-396204  
Guideline Name 
Gamifant (emapalumab-lzsg)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Gamifant  
Diagnosis 
Primary Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting a diagnosis of primary 
hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)  


=== PDF PAGE 698 ===
Page 698 
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims confirming one of the 
following:  
 
 2.1 Disease is one of the following:  
• 
Refractory  
• 
Recurrent  
• 
Progressive  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to conventional HLH therapy (e.g., 
etoposide, dexamethasone, cyclosporine A, intrathecal methotrexate)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a hematologist/oncologist  
 
AND 
 
4 - Patient has not received hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT)  
 
Product Name:Gamifant  
Diagnosis 
Primary Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) demonstrating a positive clinical 


=== PDF PAGE 699 ===
Page 699 
response to therapy (e.g., improvement in hemoglobin/lymphocyte/platelet counts, afebrile, 
normalization of inflammatory factors/markers)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient has not received HSCT  
 
Product Name:Gamifant  
Diagnosis 
Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)/Macrophage Activation 
Syndrome (MAS) in Still’s disease  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting BOTH of the following:  
• 
Diagnosis of active hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)/macrophage activation 
syndrome (MAS)  
• 
Disease occurs in known or suspected Still’s disease [e.g., systemic Juvenile 
Idiopathic Arthritis (sJIA), adult onset Still’s disease (AOSD)]  
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims confirming one of the 
following:  
• 
Trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to high-dose corticosteroids (e.g., 
methylprednisolone, prednisone)  
• 
Patient experiences recurrent MAS  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist/hematologist
